(schema)  version=0
    markdown: "Coralogix Scope. Scopes assign data access to users via groups. For more info please review - https://coralogix.com/docs/user-guides/account-management/user-management/scopes/."
default_expression  StringAttribute required
    markdown: "Default expression to use when no filter matches the query. Until further notice, this is limited to `true` (everything is included) or `false` (nothing is included). Use a version tag (e.g `<v1>true` or `<v1>false`)"
    validator: stringvalidator.regexMatchesValidator Default expression must be in the format `<vX>true` or `<vX>false where X is a version number. E.g. `<v1>true` or `<v1>false
description  StringAttribute optional
    markdown: "Description of the scope. Optional."
display_name  StringAttribute required
    markdown: "Scope display name."
filters  ListNestedAttribute required
    markdown: "Filters applied to include data in the scope."
filters[]  NestedObject
filters[].entity_type  StringAttribute required
    markdown: "Entity type to apply the expression on"
    validator: stringvalidator.oneOfValidator value must be one of: ["logs" "spans" "unspecified"]
filters[].expression  StringAttribute required
    markdown: "Expression to run"
id  StringAttribute computed
    markdown: "Scope ID."
    plan modifier: stringplanmodifier.useStateForUnknownModifier Once set, the value of this attribute in state will not change.
team_id  StringAttribute computed
    markdown: "Associated team."
    plan modifier: stringplanmodifier.useStateForUnknownModifier Once set, the value of this attribute in state will not change.
